requirements.statement: A member can sign in securely so their catalog activity is tied to their account

criteria.must: An unauthenticated visitor is directed to sign in before reaching the catalog
After signing in, the member reaches the catalog as themself

requirements.statement: A member can search for a book by title or ISBN and add it to the shared catalog without typing details by hand

criteria.must: Searching by title returns candidate matches from the book database
Searching by ISBN returns candidate matches from the book database
Selecting a candidate match adds a book to the shared catalog with its looked-up details populated

requirements.statement: A member can browse the full shared catalog

criteria.must: The catalog view lists every book any member has added

requirements.statement: A member can mark a book as read or unread for themself, independent of other members

criteria.must: Marking a book read updates that member's own read status on the book
One member's read status on a book does not change another member's read status on the same book

requirements.statement: A member can rate a book they've read on a 1-5 star scale

criteria.must: A member can set a rating between 1 and 5 stars on a book
A rating outside the 1-5 range is rejected

requirements.statement: A member can see each book's average rating and how many members have read it

criteria.must: A book's displayed average rating reflects all members' ratings for that book
A book's displayed read count reflects the number of members who marked it read

requirements.statement: A member can filter or search the catalog by title, author, their own read status, or their own rating

criteria.must: Filtering by title or author narrows the catalog to matching books
Filtering by the caller's own read status narrows the catalog to books matching that status
Filtering by the caller's own rating narrows the catalog to books matching that rating

requirements.statement: A member can remove a book they added by mistake from the shared catalog

criteria.must: Removing a book takes it out of the shared catalog for every member

requirements.statement: A member can manually enter a book's details when the title/ISBN lookup finds no match

criteria.must: When a lookup search returns no matches, the member is offered a manual-entry path
Submitting manually entered title and author adds the book to the shared catalog
